topic: 3 Cheap Instagram Reels That Bring Walk‑In Customers to a Cafe
title: 3 Cheap Reels That Bring Walk‑Ins to Your Cafe
title_options: Make Reels That Drive Cafe Walk‑Ins
Quick Instagram Reels for Cafe Foot Traffic
Low‑Cost Reels to Get Customers Now
description:
Three cheap, 15‑second Instagram Reel ideas you can film today. Each reel highlights a limited‑time in‑shop offer to turn scrollers into customers.
No fancy gear. No paid ads. One clear example shows wording, shot list, and estimated costs so you can film and post in under an hour.

scenes.doodle_prompt: small cafe storefront, sidewalk with one person walking

scenes.narration: Make a 15‑second lunchtime Reel offering a one‑day free pastry with any medium coffee purchase.
Shoot three quick clips: coffee pour, pastry close‑up, smiling customer at door. Use natural light, phone on tripod.
scenes.doodle_prompt: coffee cup pouring, pastry on plate, customer opening door

scenes.narration: Voice line: "Today only — free pastry with any medium coffee until 2PM." Keep it urgent and friendly.
Caption: "Free pastry with medium coffee today until 2PM. Pop in — no code needed." Add local hashtags and location tag.
scenes.visual_query: phone showing social post over counter
scenes.doodle_prompt: phone in hand, heart icons floating, small map pin nearby

scenes.narration: Film one staff member saying "See you soon!" at the door. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
